headline: Market Next Week: These figures from India to the US will set the market's direction next week
summary: The Sensex and Nifty 50 closed lower last trading week. Economic figures from India to the United States are due next week and will shape the market's direction.
why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the benchmark equity indices of India's National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange, reflecting the country's largest listed companies.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The Nifty 50 is the other benchmark named as having closed lower and facing the same data releases.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
